condition_or_signal: Suspected breach, account takeover, audit pipeline disabled or data corruption
response: Contain access or write path, preserve evidence and open incident
evidence_source: Grafana security events, audit and provider logs

condition_or_signal: Production unavailable or core journey error budget exhausted
window_or_threshold: Sustained window finalized from PRO-04 SLO
response: Check deployment and dependencies, then rollback or follow recovery runbook
evidence_source: Synthetic check, HTTP metrics and traces

condition_or_signal: Database unavailable, backup failed or restore evidence expired
window_or_threshold: Immediate for outage or backup failure; restore expiry set in TEC-06
response: Protect writes and start database recovery procedure
evidence_source: Provider metrics, backup status and restore register

condition_or_signal: Critical dead job exists or oldest queue age exceeds approved threshold
window_or_threshold: Dead job greater than zero for critical task or sustained queue age
response: Inspect root cause before stop or replay
evidence_source: Graphile Worker metrics, job logs and outbox lag

condition_or_signal: Search or Place p95 latency or error rate exceeds PRO-04 target
window_or_threshold: Sustained window finalized after load test
response: Trace slow path and compare with previous release
evidence_source: HTTP metrics, database spans and release marker
notes: Do not alert on one isolated request

condition_or_signal: External provider timeout or fallback rate exceeds approved threshold
window_or_threshold: Sustained window and minimum request count
response: Activate fallback and review provider status
evidence_source: Dependency spans, provider status and quota
notes: Separate provider failure from client cancellation

condition_or_signal: Unusual security pattern without confirmed compromise
response: Triage, preserve evidence and escalate when correlated
notes: May elevate to P1 or P0

condition_or_signal: Storage, telemetry ingest or monthly cost exceeds forecast
window_or_threshold: Budget threshold and growth rate finalized with Finance
response: Review sampling, retention and capacity before changing plan
evidence_source: Provider usage, invoice and approved forecast
notes: Never hide incidents by dropping required security events

condition_or_signal: Repeated login or MFA failures by account, IP or device
response: Rate limit and triage; elevate for privileged account or correlated success

condition_or_signal: User, role or permission created, elevated, disabled or policy bypass attempted
response: Verify owner, revoke unexpected access and preserve audit evidence
evidence_source: OIDC, application audit and deployment records
notes: Planned changes require approved change reference

condition_or_signal: 401 or 403 burst, cross-record access or restricted module enumeration
window_or_threshold: Threshold finalized from normal Admin behavior
response: Block or rate limit when approved and investigate actor context

condition_or_signal: Restricted evidence viewed or downloaded outside normal role, time or volume
response: Revoke signed access and review actor and object scope
notes: Evidence URL must not appear in general logs

condition_or_signal: Large export, repeated pagination or unusual object reads
response: Suspend export path if safe and preserve export evidence
evidence_source: Application, database, R2 and audit events

condition_or_signal: Audit write failed, alert rule disabled, security log volume unexpectedly zero or clock drift detected
window_or_threshold: Immediate for audit failure; missing-data window finalized in TEC-06
response: Rollback privileged mutation where applicable and open incident
evidence_source: Application, Grafana and provider control-plane events
notes: Telemetry health needs an independent signal

condition_or_signal: Environment, token, webhook, deployment or database access policy changed
response: Rotate or revert, verify change authority and inspect access
evidence_source: Render, R2, OIDC and repository deployment records

condition_or_signal: Mass state change, impossible transition, duplicate payment evidence or unexpected delete
window_or_threshold: Domain thresholds finalized from PRO-02 and TEC-04
response: Freeze affected write path and reconcile source of truth
evidence_source: Application, database audit and finance evidence
notes: Severity may be P1 when scope is contained
